tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i lag len gsal bar byed pa dpal he ru ka dgyes pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lag len gsal byed/ dpal he ru ka dgyes par byed pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal ldan lhan cig skyes dga'i rol rtsed ni/ /zab gsal khrag 'thung dpal gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gnyug ma'i rig mchog rdo rje bdag med de/ /'khor ba sgrol mdzad de la gus btud nas/ /bla ma mchog gi man ngag la brten cing*/ / rang gi mos pa gtso bor ma byas par/ /rgyud rgyal mchog gi dgongs don ji bzhin du/ / rtsa ba kha skong sbas pa'i lugs bshad bya/ /shan+ti pa sogs ye shes zhabs lugs len/ /nā ro mai tri ḍom bhi chung ba sogs/ /gur brtag gcig tu bris la kha skong gzhan/ /mi thub sogs kyis rgyud sde sna tshogs blangs/ /mtsho skyes lugs la'ang 'khrugs sdebs mang du dgos/ /snga phyi bod la'ang 'dod lugs dpag tu med/ /de dag kun kyang byin rlabs che ldan zhing*/ /phyogs re nas ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa'ang lags/ /'on kyang gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /ston pas chos lam mtha' yas gsungs/ /rtsa bshad cha mthun rgyud rnams kyang*/ /cho ga gcig tu bsre mi dgos/ /'dir ni rgyud rkyang man ngag gi /lugs bzhin gsal bar bri bya ste/ /dpal ldan zhi ba sbas pa dang*/ /lha 'byung bla ma mchog las brgyud/ /de la don tshan nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ /snying po dgyes rdor sgrub thabs dang*/ /gtor chog yum gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ /mdor bsdus he ru ka gsum gyi/ /sgrub thabs rgyas pa re re dang*/ /de bzhin 'bring dang bsdus pa dang*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ /sa chog sta gon dkyil 'khor zhag / sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dbang bskur dang*/ /slar bsdu ba dang rab gnas dang*/ /sbyin bsreg tshogs 'khor maṇ+ḍal mchod/ /las tshogs phra mo'i rim pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa ste/ / lag len rim pa 'di shes nas/ /rgyud rgyal bla ma mchog la zhus/ /de nas rtse gcig sgrubs gyur na/

dngos grub 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ / mdor bstan pa'i sdoms so/ /de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis dgyes rdor du gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags nas/ sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ tshad med bzhi sogs spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du e las chos 'byung dkar po/ de'i dbus su laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi rnam par shes pa gnas te/ 'byung bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud bzhi 'gyel ba'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ nyi ma'i steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po kham ser/ nub tu nye dbang nag po/ byang du drag po dkar po byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyi a ā

nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes pa'i bar/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las thod pa dang aṃ las gri gug hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing nag zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar lhag ma rgyab zhal bzhi gnag pa/ steng zhal dud kha cher khros pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu rgyan can/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ hūṃ gi sgra sgrog cing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i nang gi g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo dang bcas pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta/ gsum pa na bong bu/ bzhi par glang*/ lnga pa na rnga mong*/ drug pa na mi/ bdun pa na sha ra bha/ brgyad pa na byi la/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu lha/ gsum pa na rlung lha/ bzhi pa na me lha/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha/ bdun pa na gshin rje/ brgyad pa na nor bdag go /zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pas tshangs pa dang drag po/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis dbang po dang nye dbang mnan pa/ sku la thal chen gyis nye bar byugs shing*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ sgeg pa dpa' ba nas/ ldan pa nyid ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thal ba spangs pa/ gzhan bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po as mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa sogs/ oṃ pad+ma su kha sogs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems las lha mo brgyad du gyur/ mkha' nang nas phy-ir spros/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du dbang po la sogs pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon phag pa/ nub tu bet+ta lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngo nag g.yas seng ge /g.yon dgra sta/ shar lhor shā bā rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon 'khar gsil/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa li sngo bsangs g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol/ nub byang du ḍom+bi ni khra mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ thams cad kyang g.yon rkyang gi gar stabs dang*/ mgo rlon gyi do shal can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur te/ yab yum 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i nas/ ma mdzad cig /lha mo brgyad po yang thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid hūṃ dang aṃ du gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o 'i bar gong bzhin/ slar yang gong bzhin mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su yongs su zhu ste/

rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ hūṃ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shāṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams su gyur/ de las gtso bo yab yum lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang*/ sems can thams cad kyi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi nang gi khams bzhi rnams sbyangs/ ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi la bkod/ tshur 'dus lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ gtso bo yab yum rang nyid la thim ste bdag por bzhugs/ lha mo brgyad po phyogs mtshams kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau ri nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar yang nyi ma'i gdan la gaṃ tsaṃ sogs/ thams cad kyi mig tu moṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dwai las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ snar khaṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar iṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar ni las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sa 'og spyod ma dkar mo'i thugs kar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par āḥlas sa spyod ma dmar mo'i thugs kar yang gsung rdo rje āḥ snying gar hūṃ las mkha' spyod ma nag mo'i thugs kar yang thugs rdo rje hūṃ/ de thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ nai wi t+ya 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa thogs te dbang bskur/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rdo rje glu blangs/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i mchod/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gur gum dang me tog gi char phab/ rnga bo che sgra sgrags/ shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ 'khor lo bzhir bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing*/ gtso bo yab yum dang gau rī dang*/ puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā bā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bet+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom bī ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs kyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa cung zad bsgom/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ aṣ+ta dang*/ de ba pi tsu ci nus bzla/ 'khor gyi snying po ni/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥshāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūṃ/ ces pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang nā da'i bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs par bzhag /slar phyag gnyis pa'i he ru kar gyur/ mig tu moṃ las nas/ 'dzin pa'o/ / dge ba bsngo/

snying po dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te dang po'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ gtor ma 'dus byas la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ aḥlas thod pa dkar po rnams brtsegs pa/ thod pa'i nang gi dbus su hūṃ las sha chen dang dri chu/ shar du bh+ruṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu hrīḥlas byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ shar lhor bh+ruṃ las ba glang gi sha /lho nub tu hūṃ las khyi'i sha /nub byang du hrīḥlas rta'i sha /byang shar du traṃ las glang po che'i sha /ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ dri dang kha dog dang ro nus ngan pa rnams bsal/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams/ yongs su zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po gyur/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lan gsum babs shing*/ de nyid kyang rdzas rnams la thim/ slar yang steng du oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang rgya mtsho la sogs par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste/ yi ge 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang bdud rtsir zhu ste gtor ma la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum sogs ci rigs brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pa dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha klu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong lha klu dang bcas pa la reg pas/ skad cig gis 'od gsal du zhugs nas dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par bzhengs/

oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ/ oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ khaṃ zhes chu gnyis dang*/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra i maṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa ma ma shin+taṃ rak+ṣañtsa ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis bcom ldan 'das la phul/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ a nai rāt+ma aṃ i maṃ sogs/ gau rī gaṃ /tsau rī tsaṃ/ bait+ta lī baṃ/ ghasma rī ghaṃ/ puk+kasī saṃ/ shā bā rī shaṃ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī laṃ/ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ/ zhes pa rnams la mgor oṃ āḥ dang*/ mjug tu i maṃ sogs sbyar ba lan gsum mam re res phul/ phyi rol 'byung po'i tshogs la dmigs te/ oṃ in da dza ma sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ thams cad la thun mong du/ gong bzhin chu gnyis dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du nai bi t+ye 'i bar dang*/ shap+ta yang phul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ / sogs dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma brgyad dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ /lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /

nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'phrin las gzhol/ kol+la i ri ṭhi sogs rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ / sogs smon lam btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa la/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sha shwa to me bha ba/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me sogs dang*/ mjug tu mu bsnan pa yi ge brgya dang bco lnga pas bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba'am/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /gal te tshul 'dis bdag med lha mo bco lnga bsgom par 'dod na/ rang skad cig gis bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la aṃ/ de'i 'od zer gyi nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i lha snam shar dkar nas/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis rim/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams dang*/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang dang 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du zla ba'i gdan re re/ mtshams kyi pad 'dab nang ma bzhi la/ bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re dang*/ gzhan rnams kyi steng du mi ro'i gdan re re'o// dbus kyi gdan gyi nas/ bar du aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa nas/ rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog mthing nag drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po bsgreng ba/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/

zla ba'i 'od 'phro zhing*/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can no/ /thugs ka nas ā li tshar bcu bzhi spros/ ro gdan bcu bzhi'i steng du 'khod/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ kā li tshar bcu bzhi spros te de'i steng du 'khod pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ ā i/ ī u/ ū ṛ/ ṝ l̥/ l̥̄ e/ ai o/ au aṃ rnams spros te nyi zla rnams kyi bar du 'khod pa gri gug bcu bzhir gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ slar 'dus te thim/ so so'i gnas su de rnams gcig tu 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ nang gi shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo/ nub chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du mkha' 'gro ma/ 'phar ma phyi ma'i 'dab ma la dbang ldan du puk+ka sī/ mer ri khrod ma/ bden bral du gdol pa mo/ rlung du g.yung mo/ shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu besta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad kyang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma dang mtshungs pa'i sku can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas/ 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i aṃ/ thams cad kyi mig tu nas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing*/ gtso mo dang gau rī dang*/ puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma dang tsau rī dang shā bā rī dang sa spyod ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang ba'i gau rī dang bait+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom bi nī dang chu'i rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' spyod ma rnams la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ bstod pa ni/ bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur/ /phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/ / bar 'dir dang por nag po rab tu bsgom zhes sogs la bslab bo/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ aṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gtso mo'i dang*/

oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags so/ /nye bar bsdu ba ni/ gong bzhin las slar yang rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ ces 'don pa spo/ gtor chog gi skabs/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i tshab tu/ rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhes dang*/ gtor sngags gyi skabs/ de ba pi tsu badz+ra gyi thad du oṃ a ā nas/ oṃ aṃ gi bar bcug pa kho nas gtso 'khor rnams la dus gcig tu 'bul ba dang*/ bstod pa'i skabs/ bud med kyis 'dul sogs khyad par ro/ /bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba zhig sgom pas chog pa las/ rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ rang skad cig gis dgyes rdor du zhes pa nas/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ nyin ma'i steng du ro'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la yang ro'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du nas/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i nas/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod khrag thugs kar zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag med ma dang 'dra ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/

nub tu bait+ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor shā bā rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ nub byang du ḍom+bu nī rnams nag mo gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing*/ don bdag med ma'i skabs bzhin dran par bya'o/ / rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i nas/ gnas pa'i hūṃ/ thams cad kyi mig tu nas/ he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ / bzlas pa'i skabs/ oṃ trai lo kya ak+ṣe ba hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla ba dang*/ gtor ma'i skabs gtor sngags kyang*/ oṃ trai lo kya a k+ṣe pa i maṃ ba liṃ sogs 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par te/ gzhan snying po dgyes pa rdo rje bzhin byas pas legs par 'grub bo/ /sku dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //gsung gi he ru ka sgom par 'dod na'ang 'di nyid dang 'dra ba las/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum rdo rje phag mo bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas skyes pa'i thod pa lha dang lha ma yin gyi khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de man chad sku rdo rje'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gtor sngags kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /gsung dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //thugs kyi he ru ka sgom par 'dod pas/ ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug sogs/ gyen du brdzes pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus sngo ba'i zhal can/

phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje 'phyar ba/ gnyis pa na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po mdung rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa na dril bu/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa las/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis khams gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi ro gdan la gnas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ zhes pa man chad sku'am gsung gi he ru ka dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ste gtor sngags kyang rigs 'gre'o// de ltar na he ru ka gsum gyi skabs 'dir mngon rtogs rgyas pa'o/ /thugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te drug pa'o// //da ni he ru ka gsum po de dag gi mngon rtogs 'bring du sgoms par 'dod pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba nas/ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du pad nyi dang mi ro'i gdan/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka zhes mtshams sbyar la/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum po gang rigs gong bzhin gsal btab nas/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i nas/ hūṃ/ mig tu moṃ las gti mug nas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs kyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod lhag ma sngar dang 'dra/ gtor chog gi skabs su/ lha dgu ka la phul bas chog kyang*/ gtso rkyang la 'bul bar mos na/ lha dgu'i zhes dang*/ lha mo rnams kyi gtor sngags bor bas chog go /he ru ka gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'bring po'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ tshad med bzhi'i rjes la/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūṃ gi rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid dpal he ru ka zhes mtshams sbyar nas gsum po gang rung du bskyed la/ rang gi snying gar nas/ hūṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ras mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ man chad 'bring po'i skabs dang 'dra/ de ltar na 'bring bsdus gnyis la 'khor gyi lha tshogs sgom mi dgos so/ /he ru ka 'di gsum 'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba'i mdog /yang na sngo dang nyi ma'i mdog /ces gsungs pa'i mthing ga'am/ smug nag gang mos pa zhig gi chog par gsal lo/ /de bzhin du gar stabs mdzad pa rnams la ro'am/ lha'i gdan gyi snying gar nyi zla'i gdan byed pa'ang rung zhing*/ snying po he ru ka la gau rī sogs/ sgo mtshams la 'god pa dang*/ bdag med ma la pad 'dab rim gcig dang*/ gau rī sogs lha snam la bkod kyang chog go /he ru ka gsum gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// //da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ dbyung ba nyid kyis ltung bar byed/ /zhes sogs ltar rlung phyir dbyung ba rngul mtha' can dang*/ nang du bcing dgang ba dang*/ kha sbyor du gnas pa bum pa can dang*/ ma ning gi sbyor ba gzhil ba ste/ de rnams lta stangs dang bcas pas legs par bslab pa ni/ phra mo'i sbyor ba yin la/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ni gtum mo ste/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi man ngag bzhin gsal 'debs pa las/ de yang lte ba 'khor lo dkar po/ snying ga'i nag po/ mgrin pa'i dmar po/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo ljang khu'am/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'am/ dkar dmar nag gsum 'dres pa/ dbus su rim pa bzhin du/ āṃ hūṃ oṃ haṃ dmar ser dang sngo skya dang dmar po dang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i mdog can rnams gsal btab la/ thur sel gyi rlung gis bde ba bskul zhing*/ bum pa can ma ning gi rlung sbyor la brten nas/ chu tshod re re 'khor lo gzhan gsum la sems gtad cing*/

chu tshod dgu lte ba'i aṃ yig la mnyam par 'jog pa'am/ de tsam bzhag par mi nus na chu srang gi grangs la de ltar sbyar te sgom/ de la gom nas dbu ma'i nang gi 'bar 'dzag la bslab pa ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ / ci ste gtum mo bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod na/ lte ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du a thung dmar po la mnyam par 'jog pa ni khyad par ro/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad la lha sku sgyu ma lta bur mos shing*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya sgom pa'i nyams kyis yang yang rgyas btab pa na/ snang ba gang shar thams cad bde gsal stong ba gang rung gi grogs su gyur pa'i tshe/ de nyid kyi nyams bskyang bar bya ste chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yid kyis sgom pa'i rig ma'am/ pad+ma can la sogs pa dngos kyi rig ma la brten pa dang*/ rten gyi dbang gis thabs las kyang ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos bzung zhing*/ de las byung ba'i nyams bde stong la mnyam par 'jog pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams kyi rlung sems dbu mar thim pa na 'dod chags chen po'i ye shes zhes bya ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i bde ba chen po'i sems dang*/ de las rang shar du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa shes bya thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ni/ phyag rgya chen po dngos yin la/ de'i rgyud bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ phyag rgya snga ma gsum dang*/ bya spyod thams cad dang*/ snang grags thams cad rnam par mi rtog pas zin par byed pa yang*/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming btags pa ste phyag rgya chen po'o/ /de yang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i nges pas sgom ste/ de rnams kyi man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya zhing*/ go don ni rgyud kyi rgyal po las shes par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te dgu pa'o// //da ni dkyil 'khor gyi las rim rnams mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod par bya ste/

de las cho ga dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ dbang gi bya ba'i las dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgyas par na spyi dang 'dra yang*/ mdor bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas ni/ oṃ in da sogs kyis 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma btang la/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi// dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ / ces gsol ba btab/ sa'i lha mo las kyang bslang ba las/ mchod gtor phul nas/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol/ a mṛ ta bzlas la ba byung gis dkyil 'khor gyi sa la byug cing*/ dri bzang gis chus gtor la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+rir bha ba badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir rang nyid 'dug la/ skyabs sems nas brtsams bzlas pa'i bar bya/

oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nam mkhar bteg /mchod bstod cung zad bya/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ hūṃ zhes snyems pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi bcag par bya'o/ /spro na/ oṃ gha gha sogs phur gdab bya/ mthar oṃ rak+ṣa 'i sngags kyi sa gzhi bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo/ /sa chog gi rim pa'i skabs te bcu pa'o// //gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsol btab kyi skabs/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la bstim/ sa chog byas pa'i phyogs la khar sang nam mkhar bteg pa'i sa'i lha mo de sngon du ye shes pa'i tshul gyis bstim dgos so/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ rdul tshon 'dri na las thig btab pa'am/ min na'ang lha gnas ma 'chol par dgos pas/ nang bar lha mtshan 'bri sar dri bzang gi tshom bu'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ lag len bzhin mchod gtor bshams/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nas/ thags bzang rigs dud kha rnams gan rkyal du gnas par gyur/ sa chog byas na/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha spyan 'dren pa yin la/ sa chog ma byas pa'i phyogs la de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' khyab spyan 'dren pa blo yul du bzhag nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/

/ shar du gau rī nag mo nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ / bar der mchod pa gsar du bshams yod na/ mchod pa byin rlabs mdor bsdus spyi dang mthun par bya/ bsdu na/ hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan mang du brjod/ chu gnyis la gong du bshad pa'i sngags lan gsum re bzlas la/ de ba pi tsu lan bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhri pra ba ra sat+ka ra ar thaṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ spro na dkyil 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar yang de bzhin du sbyar te mchod yon phul/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pād+yaṃ sbyar bas zhabs bsil phul/ oṃ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*/ /gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags na/ /so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ yid dga'i snying po ro mchog ldan/ /bdug spos bla re dri zhim 'di/ /bdag gis= /so sor= /dhu pe/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel 'di/ /bdag gis= /so sor= /ā lo ke /gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i dri/ /skye gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag gis= /so sor= /gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid 'ong dge /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis= /so sor= /nai bi t+ya/ de las gzhan yang sogs/ shap+ta/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dngos su rigs bdag la phul/ lha so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs pa yid kyis dran par byas nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'khor ba kun 'grub khyod/ / snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub ste/

/kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje he ru ka dpal bstod/ / ces bstod pa dang lhan cig rol mo'i sgra bya zhing*/ spro na de'i rjes su mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyi shu pa sogs ji ltar rigs pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong lha klu zhes pa man chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ gshegs gsol gyi skabs gtor mgron 'jig rten pa rnams kho na gshegs su gsol ba yin no/ /de nas thod pa'i snod du sha chen gyi spos sbyar ba'am/ de ltar mos la/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ / bdag med lhan cig yang dag sbyor/ / zhes sogs kyi snyan gsan phab/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag spyi bor ldog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul/ spyan ma drangs kyi bar du 'dir bzhugs la bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa dang*/ nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlabs te/ bdag la byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bdag slob mar bcas pa la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs ci rigs pas gsol ba btab/ rak+ṣa 'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsrung bas bskor/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni dbang bum dgu dang las bum gcig te bcu'am/ bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis legs par bkrus shing*/ gos gtsang ma dkar po'am ser pos g.yogs/ mgrin par srad bus lan bdun du dkris shing*/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ dri bzang gi chu gtsang mas bkang*/ rin po che lnga dang*/ sman lnga dang*/ 'bru sna lnga rnams blugs/

sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yang sbyar/ yal gas kha rgyan me tog 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag /bum pa'i steng ngam stegs bu gzhan du/ dung chos sam thod pa'i snod du mchod yon bshams/ de la mchod pa'ang bshams shing*/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bskyed chog spyi dang 'dra ba las/ bum pa dgu yod na dbus kyi bum par/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sogs dang*/ shar gyi bum par gau rī nag mo sogs bskyed lugs rigs pas bsgre zhing*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gcig pu yin na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes pa nas/ gan rkyal du gnas pa'i bar/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar du gau rī nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ chu gnyis phul/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de'i rjes su slar yang chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams sngags kyi phul zhing*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ yab yum 'dod chags chen pos snyoms par zhugs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ste/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ci rigs par bzla zhing*/ mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta 'i sngags kyang bzla'o/ /de bzhin du/ las thams cad pa'i bum par hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bsdigs pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzlas/ snga ma bzhin mchod la/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/

/dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig / mchod yon gyi lhag ma de rdzogs par blug la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ 'di skad cig gis bskyed cing*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa med pas gshegs pa'am bzhugs pa gang yang mi dgos so/ /slob ma sta gon ni/ mdor bsdu na/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gsal 'debs su bcug cing*/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / sogs gsol ba 'debs/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ / sogs spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags bya/ snying po'i sngags kyis slob ma la bsrung ba byas/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod cing bdud rtsis thig le bya/ de la me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab rnams phul/ de nas so shing dor ba dang*/ khyor chu byin pa dang*/ bsrung skud byin pa dang*/ ku sha ster ba rnams dang*/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / zhes sogs brjod pa zab mo'i chos la spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba rnams nges par bya la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur na/ gsol btab kyi sngon du nang dbang bskur ba dang*/ rmi lam brtag pa'i mthar rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba'i don bshad nas/ dgongs gsol sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ / zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum/ de dag thams cad cho ga spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lhag gnas sta gon gyi skabs te bcu gcig pa'o// //gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba ni/ nangs par sngar langs te/ thig tshon rnams kyi mdun du mchod pa bshams/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ thig tshon rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/

oṃ las byung ba'i sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ dkar po rnam snang gi= aṃ las byung ba'i= ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo/ dz+riṃ las byung ba'i= dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dang rdul tshon ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu dang rdul tshon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan bcu/ gnyis su med par thim/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ zhes bzla zhing thig skud bsgril/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes thig sne slob ma la gtad/ dang por ye shes kyi thig thig chen brgyad btab/ oṃ badz+ra sū tra sa ma ya ma tri kra ma hūṃ/ zhes so/ /de nas las thig gi cha dbye bar bya ste/ de la yab kyi dkyil 'khor ni 'phar ma gcig pa yin pas/ nang gi zlum thig phyi ma sgo bzhi'i tshangs thig dang 'brel ba'i thad/ rtsa thig la reg par gdab cing*/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor la ni 'phar ma gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ pad+ma nyis rim du byas na ni/ zlum thig phyi ma yab kyi de dang 'dra ba las/ zlum thig nang ma ni g.yas g.yon du cha chung bcu pa'i steng nas bskor bar bya ba yin la/ pad 'dab rim pa phyi ma med pa la ni cha chung bcu pa'i zlum thig skor ba kho na'am/ bcu gnyis pa'i mtshams nas bskor ba ji ltar bde bas rung ngo*/ kha cig ni pad+ma'i lte ba cha chung brgyad par byas nas/ 'dab ma'i thig la/ zlum po nang ma bcu pa dang*/ phyi ma bcu drug gi mtshams nas bskor bar 'dod de/ de thams cad mi 'gal bar mngon no/ /thig gi bya ba zin pa na/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du bzlas nas/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas thig rnams bteg par mos la/ slob dpon dbus su zhugs te/ hīḥhīḥ zhes sgo'i thad ka'i rtsa thig phyes/

dbus kyi phur khung rdul tshon gyis bgang zhing*/ dang por slob dpon gyis ji ltar rigs pa nas bri'o/ /de la snying po'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la dbus kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa nyid yin gyi/ rgyud las ma gsungs pas gri gug 'bri mi dgos la/ sna tshogs rdo rje thabs dang thod khrag shes rab mtshon pa'i yum gyi mtshon don yang tshang ngo*/ / legs par bris zin pa na rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor bzhin du/ yig brgya lan mang du bzlas/ bod rnying pa rnams kyi lag len dang mthun par/ bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ khrus gsol rnams kyang byas na legs par 'gyur zhing*/ mchod gtor dang rgyan bkram zhing*/ bum pa rnams kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor nas gtso bo'i bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas dang*/ las bum g.yon du bzhag /gzhan rnams lha rang rang so so'i gnas sam/ de dang de'i thad kyi phyi rol tu bzhag go /mi bde ba med na gtso bum yang dbus su 'jog par slob dpon snga ma rnams bzhed pa ltar bya la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jog par mi bde na/ bzhag par mos shing phyogs gzhan du bzhag kyang chog go /rnam rgyal bum pa gcig pu yin na/ lha so so'i sngags dang bcas thams cad du 'jog tshul byas nas/ mthar rang gnas su bzhag go /dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba'i skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o// //bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ 'di la bdag mdun tha dad du sgrub pa la mos na tha dad dang*/ gcig tu sgrub pa la mos na gcig tu ste/ dang po ltar na bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams legs par bskyed cing*/ de'i gtso bo dang bdag nyid dbyer med du mos shing*/ rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs te/ bgegs bsal la lus nang du bcug /gsang ba'i pad+ma nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spros te/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod cing gsol btab nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la gzhug /sta gon gyi lha dang bsre ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba rnams byed pa yin pa/ rdo rje gur sogs las rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud la cho ga rgyas pa 'os shing*/ de'i phyir 'dir yang de bzhin byed pa skyon dang bral ba'i lugs yin no/ /'on kyang brtag pa gnyis pa 'dir ni sgom pa kho na gtso bor gsungs shing*/ las kyi rim pa'i spros pa shin tu nyung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor yang bsdus pa tsam bstan pa'i phyir/ snying po'i dgos don ma tshang ba med pa'i spros pa chung ba nyid bsngags pa yin pas/ 'dir yang bdag mdun dbyer med du sgrub pa nyid bzang ngo*/ /de ltar na 'di skad ces bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ spro na skyabs 'gro sogs sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum yang byas la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ bsrung 'khor du gyur/ ces pa nas/ ra las dang*/ hūṃ las dang*/ hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rnams dor/

de'i nang du gzhal las khang nas/ gan rkyal du gnas pa/ dbus su thod pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ shar du gri gug /lhor ḍa ma ru/ nub tu rus sbal/ byang du sbrul/ byang shar du seng ge /shar lhor dge slong*/ lho nub tu 'khor lo/ nub byang du rdo rje rnams lha dgu'i bdag nyid du gnas par gyur/ dbus kyi thod pa'i gnas su/ rang skad gcig gis dgyes rdor du gsal ba'i zhes pa nas/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o 'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/ lhag par gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a mṛ ta lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes pa'am/ oṃ gau rī dzaḥ oṃ tsau rī hūṃ/ oṃ bait+ta lī baṃ/ oṃ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes pa gang rung gis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya'o/ /slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes nas/ sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa phul/ dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang snying ga'i nas/ bzlas pa'i bar du'ang sgrub thabs bzhin las/ rdzogs rim sgom pa dkyus la mi dgos so/ /bzlas pa ci rigs pa grub nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang las kyi he ru ka phyag gnyis pa spros te mchod pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul tshul rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad bsrung ba'i don du re shig bzhag la/ bdag 'jug gi mthar gtong ba'am/ slob ma dbang bskur zin pa'i rjes su khang steng du gtor/ phyi rol gtor ma btang ba yin na/ de'i rjes thogs 'das gtor btang kyang rung ngo*/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ skabs 'di nyid du gtong ba'am/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod na lhag gtor dang lhan cig gtong ba las/

tshogs 'khor yang skabs 'dir bya'am/ bdag 'jug gi mthar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de bzhin du sbyin bsreg kyang gnas skabs gnyis po 'dir bya ste/ de gnyis las kyang gtso bor skabs 'dir byed pa legs so/ /de bzhin du phyi rol gtor ma gtong na'ang*/ gnas skabs gnyis pa der bya la/ phyi rol gtor ma mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin no/ /'on kyang kho bo cag gi bla ma gsang sngags rig pa de dag 'di ltar bzhed de/ nang gtor 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis phul zhing*/ phyi rol tu ma btang bar/ bar 'dir sbyin bsreg gis lha rnams mnyes par byas/ de nas phyi rol ba'i gtor ma btang zhing*/ slar nang du 'ongs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba yin la/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe yo byad 'dzoms na/ slar yang sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor los lha mnyes par bya ste/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba yang yang gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di nyid lag len du bzung bar bya'o/ /ci ste dus dang yo byad ma 'dzoms na sbyin bsreg dang tshogs 'khor 'di dag yid kyis sgom pa kho nas kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i dbang du byas nas 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar gyi/ sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo gnyis zin pa na/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyi rol gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa khyer/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong ba bcu lha klu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ/ sogs kyis chu gnyis phul/ oṃ in da dza ma sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gong bzhin nyer spyod rol mo yang phul/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ / zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ bkra shis smon lam bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams kyang gong bzhin byas la/

rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te gtor ma ring du btang ngo*/ /slob dpon gyis aṣ+ta bzla zhing tshams rngam bya/ slar nang du 'ongs te las bum gyi chus nye reg byas te/ bdag 'jug gi bya ba la 'jug go /spros pa dor ba'i skabs 'dir sgo dbye ba la sogs pa yang mi dgos so/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i skabs te bcu gsum pa'o// // lnga pa la bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / zhes pa nas/ kun gyi sgrib med mthong bar shog / ces lan gsum/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis mig dar btang*/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog bzungs a mṛ ta sa bgegs bskrad cing*/ las bum gyis chus gtor/ gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras so/ /snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ oṃ sarba yo ga sogs dang*/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya sogs/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du bcug par gyur/ spro na phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal bar byed/ rgyud las de nyid bsdus pa la kha 'phangs mdzad pa'i phyir mchog tu legs la/ bsdu na/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ na mo mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa 'di tsam gyis kyang chog go /de la phyogs bzhi nas phyag 'tshal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+thā nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha maṃ/ zhes shar dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya at+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes lho dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brta ya mi/ zhes nub phyogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma naṃ at+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maṃ/ zhes byang phyogs nas so/

/de'i rjes su dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni spyi dang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i thugs kar dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs spros te/ lus thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas sras dang khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa rnams dgyes rdor lha dgu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs ste/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha a be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes drag tu bzla zhing*/ rdul gyi gos pa'i ras dang*/ byi la nag po'i brun gu gul dang bsres pa'i dud pas gdug / rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang gang 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /oṃ pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ho/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa/ sogs/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod sogs mig dar dgrol/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ / sogs kyi blta bar bskul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar gyur/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / ces lan gsum/ a mṛ ta lan gsum dang*/ yungs kar gtor bas bgegs bskrad/

dbang rdzas la yang las bum gyis gsang gtor bya/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las rang nyid dpal he ru ka dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes pa nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ /dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu yang hūṃ yig las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyi ngo bor gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga nas/ rnga bo che'i sgra bsgrags te shis pa brjod par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ stong pa'i ngang las aṃ yig las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyi mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra shā li ho/ zhes cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ gong bzhin chu dbang gi sngags kyi kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las dz+riṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang*/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*/ / zhes rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las byung ba'i dril bu don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gy-i dril bu'i dbang*/ / zhes rdo rje'i skabs la 'don pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes dril bu'i dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i me tog 'phreng ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta he shṝ

ch+gai mo rdo rje zhes ming gi dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na dbang rnam pa lnga po de bskur bas/ phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lngar rnam par dag cing*/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ 'byung ba lnga rnam par dag pa lha mo lnga/ dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa sems dpa' lnga/ yul lnga rnam par dag pa rdo rje ma lngar byin gyis rlabs/ bya ba las dang bcas pa yang khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs te snying gar 'khod/ rtsa sngags dang snying po lan gsum gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs sngags dbang ngo*/ / stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo can/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang gnas/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bzungs/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin pas/ phung khams dbang yul drug pa rnams rnam par dag te rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo can/ hūṃ las byung ba'i cang te thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dang gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bo'i bzung bar bgyi/ / zhes pa ni spyod pa'i brtul zhugs te/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la brten nas dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/

/sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gy-i don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / zhes lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi lus rnam par sbyangs/ 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can du gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ shar gyi lha snam la dbang stegs rin po che'i khri rim pa gsum/ pad nyi'i gdan dang bcas pa la 'khod/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin/ 'di ste sangs rgyas nas/ hi hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ / sogs/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu rdo rje snyems ma'i ngo bo/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gy-i/ / sogs/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag sogs/ shes rab ma lo bcu drug lon pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ de la yongs su 'khyud pa las byung ba'i ye shes thob ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la nas/ dbang du brjod/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ dbang gi lha rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar spros shing*/ de las dbang gi lha dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa rnams su gyur te/

oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang nyid la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ nyer spyod lngas kyang mchod/ de'i rjes su bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyod do/ / bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gy-i gnas/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi dngos/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ khams gsum sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ / sems can de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ / zhes pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/ ci ste rgyas pa la mos na/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi rjes thogs su/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ma nyams pa/ chos rjes su dran pa rdo rje'i thig /tshad med bzhi ni zur bzhi/ sgo bzhi ni rnam thar bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni kha khyer bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni sgo khang bzhi/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni rtsigs pa rim pa lnga/ rgyan rnams ni byang chub yan lag bdun/ ka ba brgyad ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /

zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*/ snying rjes spyan ni dmar po la/ / zhes pa nas/ gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ / nas/ don yod gnas/ gzugs phung gau rīr bshad pa ste/ /tshor ba la ni chom rkun ma/ /'du shes ro langs ma yin te/ /'du byed ghasma rīr rab grags/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /sa ni puk+ka si zhes bshad/ nas/ rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ / zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang*/ deng khyod rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pas/ slob dpon gyi bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ stangs stabs dang*/ 'dug stangs dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ mchod sbyin dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod dang*/ dbab pa la sogs pa 'di dag gis gzhan la phan 'dogs dgos pa yin no/ / zhes pa ni slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do/ /de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ mig thur/ me long*/ dril bu/ mda' gzhu/ chos bshad rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung ston pa dang*/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ / zhes sogs dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ gzengs bstod pa rnams kyang bya ste gzhan du shes so/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrungs/ 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du byas/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ / sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ āḥkhaṃ sogs kyis mig dar bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'od zer kyi sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/

gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje nor bur brtan pa'i ye shes mngon du byas nas/ bde ba'i rten kun da lta bu de sbom po dang ming med kyis blangs nas/ rang gi khar babs par gyur/ ji ltar 'das pa'i nas/ dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a ho mahā su khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mig dar bsal/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig tu bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrubs/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong bzhin gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bcings/ lha mo dga' sbyin nas/ mchod pa dag tu bgyis/ /kun tu ru gyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyag rgya bde ba ldan pa khyer/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ zhes brjod pas phyag rgya gtad/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ dri ba dri lan bya ste/ dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' ba// khyod ni spro bar yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod pa rtag gus sam/ /bshang gci stobs dang khrag la sogs/ /bza' ba da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smos dam tshig bzang*/ /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig /ci gsung dam tshig brten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ / zhes khas blangs/ e ma nga yi pad+ma ni/ / nas/ rtag tu bzhugs/ thar ba brten cig ho/ / zhes pang du byon/ thabs dang shes rab rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ ye shes de nyid dbang bzhi'i don can/ rgyud rnam pa bzhi la gnas pa ste/ rgod pa dag pa slob dpon nyid/ / sogs dang*/ sna tshogs dang po'i dga' ba nyid/ / sogs sh+lau ka re re brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam las dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya sgom pa la dbang*/

dam tshig tu shes rab ma mi spangs pa yin/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ de nas de'i rjes su gnang ba byin pa ni/ sna tshogs spangs pa'i skad cig la/ /bde ba chen po rnam par bzung*/ /ji srid byang chub bar du ni/ /sems can don bgyis rdo rje 'dzin/ / zhes brjod/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'di la mig dar bcings dgrol mi dgos/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ / nas/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ / zhes brjod/ rang gi ye shes nyid du gyur/ / zhes sogs dang*/ 'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid/ / sogs dang*/ 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min// sogs kyi don yid la byas te mnyam par bzhag go / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig tu nges pa'i don gyi brtul zhugs brten/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byas/ rjes kyi bya ba/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ cho ga'i rim pa gong du bshad pa de kho na bzhin las/ lag len gyi khyad par cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams mthong ba brgyud pa dang dag las shes par bya'o/ /cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ dbang rdzas rigs lnga sogs lhar bskyed pa dang*/ spro na slob ma'ang rigs lnga'i ting nge 'dzin 'pho ba dang*/ yol ba'i nang bcug gi sngon du bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ dbang gi dngos bzhi'i mgor rnal 'byor drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba yang bya ste/ 'on kyang de dag nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ 'dir ma bshad de gzhan du shes so/ /lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba yang*/ 'dis 'don pa bsgyur te rtogs par bya ba yin la/

'di dag thob pas he ru ka gzhan gsum shugs la thob par bzhed pa yin no/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //drug pa nye bar bsdu ba'i cho ga ni/ de ltar dbang bskur ba zin pa na/ slar yang sbyin bsreg gi cho ga'i lha mnyes par bya zhing*/ phyogs kyi gtor ma'am/ gong du bshad pa bzhin phyi rol gtor ma yang rgyas par btang ngo*/ /de'i rjes su mchod pa bshams/ sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ nang mchod gsang mchod/ bstod pa bsdus pa dang bcas pa'ang sngon bzhin byas la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ sems can thams cad dges pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab cing bskor ba lan gsum bya/ yid la 'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba btab bo/ /yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis nas/ gsol/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes lan gsum gyis/ ye shes pa gshegs/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la thim/ a kā ro 'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes btags pas dkyil 'khor dbyi zhing*/ mgo la rdul tshon cung zad bzhag / oṃ badz+ra kī lo ta kī la ya sar+b+ba kī la na badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ho/ zhes phur bu dbyung*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sar+b+ba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes 'o mas gtor/ rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren na skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mjug tu sbyin bsreg dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang bya zhing*/ dge 'dun gyi ston mo dang*/ yul phyogs kyi skye bo rnams tshim par bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la ni/ sa chog dang*/ thig tshon byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/

thig tshon gyi las dang*/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba rnams mi dgos pas/ bzod gsol gyi mjug kho nar/ dkyil 'khor dang rten gzhan la yang brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs tsam bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bla ma'i zhal gyi rim pa ni/ sku gsung thugs he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la yang mdzad de/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas cho ga thams cad snga ma bzhin du spyad pa las/ me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'i rjes su/ mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor chen po sprul te/ nang dbang gi tshul gyi slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor der bcug ste/ rdzas spangs pa'i dbang bskur ba yin te/ phyogs 'di la sa chog gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba'i tshe/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu ba kho na yin la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor yang bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las gzhan pa med do/ /dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu 'phros dang bcas pa'i skabs ste bcu drug pa'o// //lha la dbang bskur ba rab gnas kyi cho ga ni/ mdo tsam du na/ gong du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de dag las/ gang yang rung ba zhig gis bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho gas kyang*/ 'di la mi rung ba'i gnas skabs med do/ /de yang sta gon lhag gnas kyi rim pa sngar bzhin byas la/ rab tu gnas par bya ba la/ bgegs sbyang ba ni/ bod rnying pa rnams kyi lag len bzhin du bya la/ de ma thag tu/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūṃ/ yang hūṃ lan bdun bzlas te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba bā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes yungs dkar ram til bskor te me la dor/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri khaṃ kha/ zhes dri bzang dang*/ 'dag rdzas ci 'byor ba dang*/ chu gtsang gis dngos su bkru bar 'os pa rnams legs par bkru zhing*/

bris sku dang glegs bam la sogs pa ni gzugs brnyan la bkru'o/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis khrus gsol bar mos la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod cing*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta 'i sngags dang las bum gyis khrus gsol la/ sku phyes dang dris byugs pa dang na bza' 'bul ba rnams bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu gnas bya'i steng gi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan ༵ch+gai rdo rje mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyed la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod phyir dang*/ /sems can bsod nams spel don dang*/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid che/ khyed kyis rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ / lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ / sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang gzhan rdo rje spyan ldan rnams/ / bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje can chen ༵༵ch+gai bdag /ch+gai+e rab tu gnas pa ni/ /bgyi'o des na khyed rnams kyi/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan phab/ rigs lnga'i bstod pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra pu ṇa ra ga ma na ya muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ sku gzugs kyi gnas gsum la sogs par/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas dri bzang byugs/ phyi nang gi gtor ma rgya cher btang ngo*/ /de dag ni sta gon gyi bya ba'o/ /nangs par bdag 'jug yan chad kyi bya ba rnams zin pa na/ sngar bzhin las bum gyis khrus gsol/

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha de nyid kyi bskyed chog shes na de ltar bya la/ mi shes na mchod rten dang*/ chags bral gyi sku gzugs rnams dang*/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa ni rnam snang du bskyed/ glegs bam dang yig 'bru ni 'od dpag med dang*/ phyag mtshan rnams mi bskyod pa dang*/ slob dpon dang sku gzugs gzhan rnams ni rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de/ skye mched drug dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa dang*/ mchod bstod dang gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa gong bzhin byas la/ sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa ltar dbang lha spyan 'dren/ bkra shis kyi glu blang ba ni rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa brjod la/ chu cod pan rdo rje'i dril bu ming*/ slar yang slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du chu dbang bskur nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha 'i bar dang*/ gsang dbang shes rab ye shes bzhi pa rnams la gsol btab dang*/ rtogs bskyed dang*/ mig dar bcings grol dang*/ dri ba dri lan rnams dor nas/ dngos gzhi rnams bdag 'jug bzhin dbang bskur la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ / oṃ badz+ra wa sa s+ya hūṃ sogs/ oṃ āḥsarba a bha ra ṇa bi bhu ṣa ṇ+ya swāhā/ oṃ dz+raṃ swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis gos dang rgyan dang 'bras bu la sogs pa phul/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣuḥbi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes mig thur gyis spyan dbye zhing mig sman bku ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i sbyin bsreg byas la/ oṃ di bya ag+na sa ma sid+dh+ya na pri ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin bsreg gi me'i lhag ma la 'o thug sgrubs te gzugs brnyan shar ba'i lha'i zhal du 'bul bar bya'o/ / oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes lan mang du bzlas la/ lha de nyid bskyed pa yin na ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams zhal bsgyur la rang rang gi gzugs su blta'o/

/de nas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i don du gsol ba gdabs pa ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni rab bzhugs rnams/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs la/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ /sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ / ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun kyis 'di la byin rlabs shing*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ spro na lag len bzhin tshig lhug pas kyang bya/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas la me tog dor de/ de nas rdo rje gsor zhing bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ de nyid lnga pa'am/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs kyi bstod pa glur blang ngo*/ /bsdu na/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu grub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /

zhes bstod/ yig brgya lan mang du bzlas te lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs par brjod/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dag /gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru/ /yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang*/ / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /sa dang chu dang me rlung las/ /lha rnams kyis ni sku gzugs la/ /bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang*/ /mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas su/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo bsrung ba dang*/ /gang gnas dge par gshegs su gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab nas/ mgron du byon pa'i lha rnams ci bder gshegs la bar 'dir chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rgya cher gtong*/ slar yang sku gzugs la mchod pa rgya chen po dang*/ shis brjod sogs rgya cher bya'o/ /bgrang 'phreng rab tu gnas pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med yab yum du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod byas la/ de zhu bas bgrang 'phreng du gyur/ oṃ āḥdz+riṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rnam grangs gzhan mang po dag ni 'dir ma bshad do/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //da ni sbyin bsreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa bshad par bya ste/ de yang gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi sa chog las/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom mi dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal tsam la gnas pas bya'o/ /der zhi ba'i thab khung bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dbus su thab khung zabs su mtho gang*/ rgyar khru gang zlum po la/ dbus kyi mthil du pad+ma 'dab brgyad rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan can bya/

mchu sor bzhis bskor ba la ze 'bru 'bri/ kha khyer dpang dang rgyar sor bzhi pa la/ pang 'dab 'bri ste phyogs bzhir rdo rje rgya khram gyis mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyi nang thams cad dkar pos byugs/ sgrub pa po'i gdan gyi g.yon du chu gnyis dang bum pa bca'/ g.yas su bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu me lha'i mchod pa rnams bshams/ gtor ma yang ji ltar bde bar bzhag /kai la sha yang brtsigs la/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs rnams rang gi mdun du bsham mo/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bsgom la/ las bum sgrubs/ bum pa med na bsang chu sgrub te/ dung gi chu la 'khyil pa bzlas pas so/ /de nas nang mchod kyi rdzas rnams bsangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dang*/ a mṛ ta bzlas pas me bcug la/ oṃ dz+wa la dza la hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ hūṃ bdun gyis rlung yab g.yab/ a mṛ ta lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gcig phul/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes ku sha bkrams par mos/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thab khung gi dbus su/ 'bar ba'i me raṃ las byung ba'i me lha dkar po ra skyes la chibs pa/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ me lha 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo'i mthe bong g.yab pa'am/ dbyug gu rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /snying rjes sems can don kun mdzad/ /'dir ni yang dag mnyes par mdzod/ / ces brjod la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ sgrub thabs bzhin dbang bskur la rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/

chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa 'bul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal pau ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye ā di be ā di be ā bi sha ā bi sha mahā/ shrī ye ha bya ka bya bah+na ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes dgang blugs lan bdun sogs ji ltar rigs pa phul/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas mtha' dag 'bul zhing*/ de nas slar yang bsregs blugs gcig phul te/ yang thab kyi me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa yan chad sgrub thabs dang 'dra/ 'on kyang 'byung bzhi la rang sems bsre mi dgos/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ dang aṃ las bcom ldan 'das dpal/ sogs dang*/ shar du gaṃ las gau rī sogs/ mig tu moṃ las nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo na bza' nang mchod gsang mchod bstod pa rnams rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bar byas la/ mgor de ba pi tsu dang*/ mjug tu/ ma ma shin+tang rak+ṣan tsa ku ru sarba ar+tha sā' dhā ya swāhā/ zhes pa sbyar la/ bar du rdzas sngags re dang spel ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ mar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra la ta ye swāhā 'am oṃ bo dhi prik+ṣa ye swāhā/ gang rung gis yam shing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ta ye swāhā/ 'bras ma brugs pa dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhā/ ku sha / oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ mahā be ga ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ mahā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swāhā/ gro ste de ltar na bsregs rdzas so sor ci rigs pa 'bul la/

mdor bsdu na lha sngags kho nas phul kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams gtor ma'i cho gas tshims par byas la/ mchod bstod/ gsol gdab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba rnams bya'o/ /slar yang me lha thab khung du byon pa la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams phul nas/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ dhāṃ dhāṃ zhes btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngags nas blugs gzar gyis blangs te thab khung du 'bul/ slar yang sngon bzhin dgang blugs phul la/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bkyed cing*/ swa ar+tha na zhes sogs sam/ yang na bod skad du bya ste/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar byon cig /bdag la dngos grub thams cad mdzod/ / ces dang*/ me lha'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ muḥ zhes brjod/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /'di ni zhi ba'i cho ga snying po tsam ste/ las gzhan yang 'di las dpags te rtogs par bya'o/ /sbyin bsreg gi skabs te bco brgyad pa'o// // de ltar na bshad zin pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg la sogs pa 'di rnams mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i cho ga rgyas pa rnams legs par shes pas bsdus pa'i khyad par 'di dag nges par bya dgos so/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba mdo tsam ni/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba ni spyod pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir las dang po pa rnams kyi rim pa ltar na/ dang por yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs zhu 'bul rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ ji skad bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams las bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya/

bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rang nyid la bsdu'o/ /de'i 'og tu mdun bskyed ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud dang po bshams te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor sngags kyis phul/ de nas/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung*/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa'i lhan cig rol/ / ces drangs/ de rnams kyis kyang*/ bde bar gshegs shig chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma rnam par spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes blangs te thams cad la brims/ lhag ma snod cig tu bzhag go /de nas so so'i nas phud bsdus la de yang snga ma lhar 'bul lo/ /de ltar tshims par longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la kha phrus btab cing*/ sngar gyi lhag ma cig shos dang lhan cig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ku ru ku ru bh+yaḥwarta li warta li/ mahā warta li tshe/ dur khrod gnas mo dngos grub zhal/ khrag la dga' ma yi dwags gdong*/ /gtum mo gtsigs byed khro mo ste/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' dam tshig bsrungs/ /ki li ki li sgra sgrogs ma/ /pha mes nags nang gsol zhig bzhes/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa yi/ /gtum mo mche gtsigs dud sol ma/ /rang gi gnas su mdzod cig mdzod/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bzung zhig bzung zhig gdug can kun/ /zo zhig zo zhig ho phrai~Xṃ/ bdag cag rnams kyi sarba bigh+nān shan+tiṃ ku ru ku ru phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ a kā ro 'i sngags kyis lan gsum bsngos la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tsiṣ+ta bā liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag gtor btang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ yang rdo rje'i glu blangs te spro na gar la sogs pa ci rigs pa bya'o/

/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod cing don bsam/ a nu rā ga 'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag / rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam gdab cing*/ rgyud gzhan las gsungs pas kyang smon lam btab la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs te bcu dgu pa'o// //maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'am/ phyi rol mchod pa ni/ zhu 'bul ma gtogs bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ra las nyi ma'i nas/ gan rkyal du gnas pa/ oṃ he badz+ra ya na maḥ oṃ nai rāt+ma ya na maḥ oṃ gau rī na maḥ sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ / oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ/ shar du gau rī nag mo/ zhes sogs sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi mig tu zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya ste dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra/ yan lag bdun pa dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzungs rnams bya ste/ thugs brgyud bskul ba'i don du bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ slar yang mchod bstod nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di la 'grub cing spro na/ mchod pa'i skabs su lha re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ mchod pa'i sngags re btags te phul na shin tu legs so/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o// //da ni las tshogs sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ rang gi snying gar ā las rdo rje ma dkar mo gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ rnams 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hūṃ yig can sgom ste/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi 'bum du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de nas kham phor kha sbyor la thod le skor gyis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba la/

oṃ hūṃ ch+gai mo stam bha ya stam bha ya hūṃ swāhā/ mtha' skor du saṃ yig gis skor ba bris/ rtsibs brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha mu khyud la saṃ yig gam rtsa sngags spel tshig can bris/ kha phor gzhan sna tshogs rdo rje dang ri rab bris pa'i steng nas bkab/ de rdog pas mnan te sngags spel tshigs can khri bzlas te/ des kyang ma 'grub na/ mchod rten la sogs par sba'o/ /'di ni spel tshig gi dbye bas lus rengs pa dang ngag rengs pa gnyis car byed do/ /de bzhin du/ i las gau rī dmar ser lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa thugs kar aṃ yig la bsgom la/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa bya/ de nas bsgrub bya skra grol ba sogs mdun du bsam ste/ snying ga'am skye gnas su a yig dmar po las me 'bar te haṃ yig rab tu zhu bar bsam ste/ oṃ aṃ ch+gai+e mo bdag gis dbang du bsdus shig aṃ swāhā/ zhes zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bas bkug cing*/ 'khor lo 'bri ba ni gro ga la rgya skyegs kyis bri te/ saṃ gyi dod du thaṃ yig go /de bzhin du/ i las chu'i rnal 'byor ma sngon mo tho ba dang sdigs mdzub can/ thugs kar khaṃ yig go /oṃ khaṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo rnga mo dang bya rog gi khrag gis bris la khaṃ gis bskor ba rnga mo'i rgyab tu gnas pa'o/ /dgug gzhug drag tu byas te/ bsgrub bya gcer bu skra grol ba rnga mong la bskyon te khro bo dbyug pa thogs pas lho phyogs su gdas par bsam/ oṃ khaṃ ch+gai mo u tsi ṭa ya khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes bskrod pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ u las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ral gri dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa thugs kar dz+riṃ yig sgom la/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo rta dang ma he'am khā dang 'ug pa'i khrag gis 'bri ste dz+riṃ gis bskor ba'o/ /bsgrub bya dgug gzhug drag tu bya zhing*/ phan tshun du srog chags de dag zhon zhing 'thab par bsam nas/

oṃ dz+riṃ ch+gai mo dang ch+gai+e mo bi dwe ṣa ya dz+riṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dbye ba 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du/ bdag med ma a las byung ba dud kha spyi dang 'dra bar bskyed la/ thugs kar bu ཾ yig sgom la/ oṃ buṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas nas 'khor lo ni rims nad kyis shi ba'i thod pa la dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ nye tshe dang*/ lan tshwa rnams kyi 'dri ste/ lte bar zur drug pa la hūṃ drug / buṃ gyis skor ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsgrub bya'i bya ba snga ma dang mtshungs pa las/ nyi phyed dang nam phyed phub ma'i me la gdung bar bya'o/ / oṃ buṃ ch+gai mo rims kyis thebs par mdzod cig buṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rims kyis thebs par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ aṃ las byung ba'i mkha' spyod ma dmar mo/ snying gar hūṃ oṃ hūṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo hūṃ dang hrī dza sa bskor ba/ shing lo rlung gis khyer ba ma lhung pa la bris te/ rlung dang me'i steng du bsgrub bya myos par bsam/ snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po spros/ bsgrub bya'i sna sgo g.yas pa nas zhugs/ snying ga nas bcud phrogs te sna g.yon nas byung*/ rang gi snying gar thim/ dbugs kyi rlung gis bkug par bsams la/
